pages.text: Build a $(l)Smithy$() (Smithing research). In $(l)Blacksmith$(), choose a piece or a full armour set, a material and an amount. Smiths forge the order from the stockpile.$(br2)Materials unlock with research: leather, chainmail, iron, gold, diamond and netherite.

Equipment from $(l)Epic Knights$() and its addons and from $(l)Ice and Fire$() is found automatically. Search by name or mod; order complete matched sets or single pieces, including mount armour.$(br2)$(l)Master Armourer$() commissions loot-only equipment at a high price. Dragonsteel still needs real dragonsteel from a dragonforge.
